question: Which of the following peptides are not produced by the renal system?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Renin" -> "produced by juxtaglomerular cells in kidneys" -> "part of renal system" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Angiotensin I" -> "produced by conversion of angiotensinogen by renin" -> "occurs in bloodstream" -> "not directly produced by renal system" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Erythropoietin" -> "produced by interstitial fibroblasts in kidneys" -> "part of renal system" -> 90%
CHAIN: "1,25DHCC" -> "active form of vitamin D" -> "converted in kidneys" -> "produced by renal system" -> 90%
analysis: The question asks which peptide is not produced by the renal system. Renin is produced by the juxtaglomerular cells in the kidneys, making it a renal product. Erythropoietin is also produced in the kidneys by interstitial fibroblasts. 1,25-Dihydroxycholecalciferol (1,25DHCC), the active form of vitamin D, is synthesized in the kidneys. Angiotensin I, however, is formed in the bloodstream when renin, a renal product, converts angiotensinogen to angiotensin I. Therefore, while the process is initiated by a renal product, Angiotensin I itself is not directly produced by the renal system. Based on this understanding, Angiotensin I is the peptide not directly produced by the renal system.
